verdict.rationale: The docs describe delegating longer tasks to isolated cloud environments that run in parallel without tying up the local machine, then returning when results are ready. Work can be started from GitHub, GitLab, Linear or Slack, and non-interactive `codex exec` can be called from repeatable scripts, CI and pipelines, which covers the core of background autonomous automation. missing for 10: a documented first-class scheduled/recurring automation feature (triggers are external integrations or user-built CI scripting), and independent hands-on corroboration of unattended background runs.
